name: The Nibble Counter-Strategy
stage: De-escalation, Resistance Defusal & Countering Bad Faith
scenario: A buyer demands free premium 24/7 technical support right as the master services agreement is opened for signature.
script: "We are pleased to include our premium 24/7 support package. That tier is priced at $12,000 annually; which operational deliverable from the agreed scope would you like to eliminate to balance that cost?"
defense: Reframe the nibble: support is part of core delivery; treating it as an add-on questions the partnership integrity.
originFull: Commitment and Consistency Bias establishes that negotiators are uniquely vulnerable right before deal completion, often conceding minor additions to avoid derailing a finalized agreement.
defenseFull: Executing a nibble effectively: "In enterprise agreements of this magnitude, standard operational support is universally understood to be part of the core delivery. Treating baseline support as an add-on calls into question the integrity of the partnership."
